derivation: The owner materializes each next task or parallel frontier from durable program state.
The owner derives every UnitBudget; callers provide no budget values.
Every task in a frontier is fully reserved before any frontier member launches.
If capacity is insufficient, the parent persists a paused checkpoint before effects and resumes from that checkpoint after capacity is available.
The parent reservation is released only after semantic terminalization or a durable stopped/failed result.

effect_identity: spec hash when starting from spec
decomposition task id and run id once created
durable stage-operation ids for every launched child
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.execution_model: The prevention adapter orchestrates typed child tasks and durable receipts; it does not execute greenfield_full_drive.sh as one opaque subprocess.

reconciliation.before_workflow_identity: Reconcile completed infrastructure child receipts through the approved local-workflow-orch-image contract; launch only the first missing child.
reconciliation.fresh_validation: The validate-fresh profile reconciles the same durable program identity as resume-program, but success additionally requires a persisted validationResult.fresh=true from a newly executed round-0 smoke.
reconciliation.n1_or_n2_identity_known: Query the durable workflow run by task/run identity. Active or terminal matching work is ALREADY_APPLIED; a proved-absent deterministic identity is NOT_APPLIED; conflicts are INDETERMINATE.
reconciliation.parallel_frontier: Every child has a deterministic stage operation id and durable start intent. Reconcile each child independently; never relaunch an acknowledged matching child and never launch an unreserved sibling.
reconciliation.program_identity_known: Call workflow.greenfield.driveStatus with decompositionTaskId and programDriveId. running, stopped, completed, or failed proves ALREADY_APPLIED and selects monitor/terminal handling without relaunch. PROGRAM_DRIVE_NOT_FOUND is NOT_APPLIED only when no acknowledged program-created receipt exists; otherwise it is INDETERMINATE.

admission_rules: Resolve repository_key through the configured remote repository registry; reject raw local paths and unregistered slugs.
Resolve every host file from an approved root key plus a relative path; reject absolute paths, traversal, and resolved symlink escape.
skip_build requires a semantic image-label/source-hash verifier to pass before admission.
skip_auth requires live Codex and GitRemoteManager capability probes to pass before admission.
Remove the legacy restore_checkpoint host-path mode; current durable program state explicitly rejects legacy /tmp checkpoint authority.
create-program, resume-program, and validate-fresh pass the durable decomposition/program identities now required by workflow.greenfield.driveDag.
validate-fresh is a checkpoint-resume profile with a fixed round-0 smoke; callers cannot combine it with create-program or reuse the durable validation ledger.

terminal_contract.failure: driveStatus status stopped or failed, a conflicting durable identity, a semantic child failure, or a budget/root/schema violation produces one failed terminal event with evidence and never success.
terminal_contract.launch_is_not_terminal: A zero exit or sequence-complete marker after detached launch leaves the parent STARTED.
success_requirements: status is completed and lastDurableTransition is program_completed.
programDriveId, decompositionTaskId, decompositionRunId, repositoryKey, targetBranch, specHash, and universeHash match the prepared effect identity.
executionOrder has at most 20 unique nodes, its set equals mergedNodes, and every featureStates entry has status covered with a nonempty mergeSha.
validationResult.verdict is validated; validation_skipped is not semantic success for this full-drive owner.
For validate-fresh, validationResult.fresh is true and the validation terminal transition records fresh=true.
requirementCoverage.terminalDecision.status is covered, or not_required only when the durable required-acceptance set is empty.
The authenticated remote target-branch head equals mergedBaseSha.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id; identical replay returns the existing event and conflicting replay fails closed.

trusted_roots.remote-repository-registry: The configured repository mapping consumed by GitRemoteManager
